sourceName: Ministry of MSME & Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
documentTitle: Public Procurement Policy for MSMEs — 25% Mandatory Allocation Directive

chunks.text: Central Government Ministries and Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) such as BHEL, ONGC, TANGEDCO, Southern Railways, and NTPC must mandatorily procure at least 25% of their annual goods/services value from MSME vendors registered on GeM Portal and/or Udyam.
